text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Looking forward to working with 
you today as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after afternoon classes ended, 
Believe showed up in the trainer's room. 
She seemed somehow brimming with energy.
choice_data_list:
Looks like you got plenty of rest 
yesterday!

Looks like you got to rest up properly 
yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To the usual place... where everyone 
from the running course is.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I helped out with various things, and 
they were really happy with it."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I was treated to lots of 
delicious food, too...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's looking out for me, saying I 
should rest on my days off. They even got 
me to take a nap...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I am in very good 
condition today. I believe we will have a 
productive training session.
